name: LinkedIn
label: LinkedIn — Community Management Posts API
description: Official LinkedIn REST on https://api.linkedin.com. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Organic posts for a person or organization URN (/rest/posts), Images initializeUpload, organization lookup, OpenID member userinfo (/v2/userinfo). extraHeaders send Linkedin-Version: 202608 and X-Restli-Protocol-Version: 2.0.0 (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/versioning?view=li-lms-2026-08). access_token is never logged or returned. Do not scrape linkedin.com. Customer owns the LinkedIn developer app.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"post_create","commentary":"Hello","visibility":"PUBLIC","lifecycle_state":"PUBLISHED","author":"urn:li:organization:123"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: post_create | post_get | image_upload | organization_get | member_get | trigger.

schema.label: commentary
schema.description: Post text. Official commentary for post_create. Example: Shipping v1.2 today.

schema.label: visibility
schema.description: Full visibility object escape hatch for post_create. Typical: {"COMING_SOON"} is wrong — use {"feedDistribution":"MAIN_FEED"} inside distribution, or visibility_code.

schema.label: author
schema.description: Author URN. Official author. Example: urn:li:person:AbCdEf or urn:li:organization:123. post_create / image_upload. Also config-worthy.

schema.label: post_urn
schema.description: Post URN path for post_get. Example: urn:li:share:123.

schema.label: media
schema.description: initializeUpload request body extras for image_upload.

schema.label: distribution
schema.description: Official distribution {feedDistribution, targetEntities, thirdPartyDistributionChannels} for post_create.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). trigger is ingress — use a BPMN message event. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (post, image init, organization, or userinfo). Capped. Never contains the token.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: post_create | post_get | image_upload | organization_get | member_get | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: LinkedIn OAuth 2 member token (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Empty → no HTTP.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Keep below the daemon invoke budget. Example: 30.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
